contexts.text: The antediluvians who try to emerge from that Hell... those who obstinately persist in forcing their way out... AC 1271.
The endeavours of the Hells to force their way out appear like boilings up...
It is said that they could not emerge... because being surrounded by their own falsities from evil, they can no longer force their way out...
This volume endeavoured to struggle upwards... but... they could not force their way out. SE 3268.
They wanted to emerge, and to struggle out into the World of Spirits.
